name: zeffy
description: Analyze fundraising results and donor activity for your Zeffy nonprofit, with optional contact and offline-payment management.

interface.longDescription: Zeffy provides fundraising data analysis and reporting for nonprofit organization owners. Connect your organization to analyze donations, donor retention, campaign performance, event ticket sales, memberships and payouts. Compare revenue across periods, rank donors, identify lapsed donors and reconcile recorded payouts using the same reporting engine as the Zeffy dashboard. Access is limited to the organization selected during sign-in and is read-only by default. Owners may optionally enable contact creation, updates and deletion, and recording or deletion of offline payments. Online payments cannot be created, refunded or deleted through this connector.
defaultPrompt: How much did we raise this quarter compared to last year?
Who are our top 5 donors this year?
Which donors gave last year but not this year?
